channel.title: Semgrep incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Semgrep's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Incomplete Semgrep 1.176.1 release: PyPI installs cannot use Pro Engine [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. The Pro Engine can be installed and used normally after installing Semgrep 1.176.1 via PyPI.

item.title: SMS Scans Degraded [resolved]
item.description: Metrics show full recovery of all Semgrep products. Our engineering team will continue monitoring until the final update from AWS.

item.title: Dynamic Maven & Gradle dependency resolution impaired [resolved]
item.description: Dynamic maven & gradle scans are now operating as normal.

item.title: Widespread errors on Semgrep AppSec Platform [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been fully resolved with a successful release.

item.title: Semgrep outage between 2026-08-13 23:43 UTC and 23:52 UTC [resolved]
item.description: Semgrep experienced an outage affecting login, the API, and scans from 2026-08-13 23:43 UTC to 23:52 UTC. The incident has been resolved.

item.title: Lockfileless scans failing for certain deployments [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Fragment scanner unavailable to some users [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Findings data display lagging behind realtime [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved, and findings data is now displaying normally.

item.title: Custom SSO Login Issues [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved by the third party vendor

item.title: Adding a memory crashes the Memories page in the platform [resolved]
item.description: The fix has been released and this issue is resolved.

item.title: Scan failures with exit code 7 due to invalid rule [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Scans are now running normally.

item.title: Delays in scan processing [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Degraded scan performance in CI and Semgrep Managed Scans [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Logins are failing for users via GitHub auth [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Managed Scans: full project scans being associated with HEAD instead of the default branch name [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Scheduling delays for Semgrep Managed Scanning (SMS) [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. We are continuing to monitor the system.

item.title: Slow performance and intermittent errors in the Semgrep AppSec Platform [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. We determined that the performance degradation had multiple contributing causes and will be working to address those issues.

item.title: Degraded Scan Performance [resolved]
item.description: Between 21:48 - 22:00 UTC some managed scans experienced additional latency. The root cause has been resolved.

item.title: A small subset of users are unable to login [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Failure to start scans from 14:35 to 14:52 UTC [resolved]
item.description: From 14:35 to 14:52 UTC, Semgrep scans did not start successfully. We have mitigated the issue and scans are now starting normally.

item.title: Failures running diff-aware scans for GitHub.com customers [resolved]
item.description: Starting around 16:00 UTC, some diff-aware Managed Scans for GitHub.com projects failed due to inability to fetch information about relevant branches, coinciding with a degradation in GitHub availability. The failure rate returned to normal just after 17:00 UTC and the system is now stable.

item.title: Scans failing to start [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Login and scans are failing for some users [resolved]
item.description: The problem is resolved and scans and logins are now processing normally.

item.title: Delays for Managed scans fail-open process [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Fail-open processes for unfinished Managed Scans continue to run normally.

item.title: Teams configuration is intermittently not loading and logins slow for some users [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Supply chain dependency processing issues [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved, and scan processing is completing normally.

item.title: Semgrep AppSec Platform users with read-only access cannot see their projects [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved, and read-only users should be able to view their projects as normal.

item.title: Findings data out of date for organizations using combined Code/AI view [resolved]
item.description: All data has backfilled and the system is healthy.

item.title: Elevated error rates in Managed Scans [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and scans are behaving normally.

item.title: Elevated errors on managed diff scans [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.
